description: Billing Module 2 (model stubs + service module + the CONCRETE race-safe PayMongo webhook implementing the four Revision 4 binding fixes), Finance Module 3 (model stubs + Owner-only placeholder dashboard), and the supabase/cron pg_cron membership-expiry SQL stub. Depends on FEAT-002 (MemberProfile is the FK target for Subscription; the finance dashboard uses role_required(can_view_financials) from FEAT-001).
steps: Create apps/billing (apps.py AppConfig name='apps.billing' label='billing'; register in INSTALLED_APPS) with models.py STUBS: Subscription (ForeignKey(MemberProfile); amount_centavos PositiveIntegerField; status TextChoices PENDING/ACTIVE/EXPIRED; created_at/updated_at); Payment (ForeignKey(Subscription); amount_centavos PositiveIntegerField; status TextChoices PENDING/PAID/FAILED; paymongo_payment_id CharField unique+db_index; created_at; updated_at); WebhookEvent (event_id CharField unique; received_at; status TextChoices PROCESSED/UNKNOWN_PAYMENT/IGNORED — NO signature_valid field, NO DEFERRED status). Amounts are integer centavos, never floats.

Create apps/billing/services.py: create_payment_intent(...) defined with signature + docstring but raising NotImplementedError this pass (documented stub; PayMongo HTTP call deferred). Implement mark_payment_paid(payment) and mark_payment_failed(payment) as the ONLY writers of PAID/FAILED — they flip Payment.status and set updated_at, and they GUARD illegal/stale transitions (a failed arriving after paid, or paid after failed, is a no-op so out-of-order redelivery cannot flip a settled payment — NIT-4).

Create apps/billing/webhooks.py: a CSRF-exempt (@csrf_exempt), POST-only view paymongo_webhook, plus the pure helper verify_signature(raw_body: bytes, header: str, secret: str, *, mode: str) -> bool. SIGNATURE (binding, Revision 4): parse the Paymongo-Signature header as comma-separated t=<unix_ts>,te=<hex>,li=<hex>; compute hmac.new(secret.encode(), msg=t.encode() + b'.' + raw_body, digestmod=hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(); NEVER call raw_body.decode() before hashing; compare with hmac.compare_digest against te in test mode and li in live mode; select mode from the event payload's livemode boolean, defaulting to test offline; secret is PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET (whsk_ prefix). On mismatch / malformed / missing header -> return 400, write NO WebhookEvent row, log only the event id if parseable (never body or payload fields).

In paymongo_webhook implement race-safe idempotency EXACTLY as the Revision 4 appendix code: inside transaction.atomic(), WebhookEvent.objects.get_or_create(event_id=event_id, defaults={'status': UNKNOWN_PAYMENT}); ALWAYS re-read with WebhookEvent.objects.select_for_update().get(pk=event.pk) so concurrent retries serialize; if not created and status in (PROCESSED, IGNORED) return HttpResponse(status=200) (terminal duplicate); wrap the whole block in try/except IntegrityError, and in the except re-open transaction.atomic(), select_for_update().get(event_id=event_id), apply the same terminal-duplicate check, then proceed. The IntegrityError catch on the unique event_id and the explicit select_for_update re-read are BOTH required.

In paymongo_webhook implement the event-type map inside the same atomic block: payment.paid / payment.failed -> look up Payment by paymongo_payment_id; if found call the single-writer mutator (mark_payment_paid / mark_payment_failed) and set WebhookEvent.status=PROCESSED; if not found set status=UNKNOWN_PAYMENT (reprocessable on a later retry). Any other/unrecognized event type -> status=IGNORED (terminal), apply no payment transition. Responses: valid+applied or terminal duplicate -> 200; unknown payment -> 200 + UNKNOWN_PAYMENT; unrecognized type -> 200 + IGNORED; bad/missing signature or unparseable body -> 400 + no row. Logs record only event id + outcome enum.
Mount the webhook at path('webhooks/paymongo/', paymongo_webhook) in profit/urls.py. Create apps/billing/admin.py and the fresh initial migration (python manage.py makemigrations billing).

Create apps/finance (apps.py AppConfig name='apps.finance' label='finance'; register in INSTALLED_APPS) with models.py stub TransactionRecord (ForeignKey(Payment); amount_centavos; recorded_at); services.py placeholder monthly_summary(...) raising NotImplementedError (no reporting math); views.py financial_dashboard guarded by role_required(can_view_financials) rendering an empty templates/finance/dashboard.html shell. Add apps/finance/urls.py, wire it in profit/urls.py, create admin.py, and generate the fresh initial migration (makemigrations finance).

Create supabase/cron/membership_expiry.sql: a commented pg_cron stub scheduling a daily Asia/Manila-aware job that flips membership_memberprofile.membership_status to 'EXPIRED' where expiry_date < current_date. The header must document that this SQL is NOT managed by Django migrations, bypasses the ORM by design (the one AGENTS.md exception), must be applied manually against Supabase, and that renaming the model requires updating this file. Table/column names must match the ORM-generated names.
acceptance_criteria: `python manage.py makemigrations billing finance` produces one migration each and `python manage.py migrate` applies them on SQLite.
`python manage.py check` exits 0 with the webhook route and finance dashboard wired.
verify_signature produces a byte-exact HMAC over t.encode() + b'.' + raw_body and never decodes raw_body before hashing.
mark_payment_paid / mark_payment_failed are the only functions that write PAID/FAILED and they no-op on a stale/illegal transition.
The finance dashboard view is 302-to-login for anonymous and 403 for a non-Owner role.
verification: Run `python manage.py makemigrations billing finance` then `python manage.py migrate` and confirm success.
Run `python manage.py check` and confirm it exits 0.
Run `python manage.py test apps.billing apps.finance` (webhook + dashboard-gate smoke coverage; the exhaustive webhook suite is FEAT-004) and confirm all pass.
Append the real command output to .agents/tasks/profit-scaffold/verification.md.
findings: FEAT-003 verified on Python 3.13.14 offline (SQLite default): makemigrations billing finance -> billing.0001_initial (WebhookEvent, Subscription, Payment) + finance.0001_initial (TransactionRecord), one each; migrate applied both OK; check=0 with the webhook route and finance dashboard wired; test apps.billing apps.finance = 21 tests OK. Hand-offs for later FEATs: (1) SETTINGS: added PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET = env('PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET', default='') to profit/settings.py (the eight env NAMES were already in .env.example from FEAT-001; this is the first setting that actually READS one). The webhook reads it via settings.PAYMONGO_WEBHOOK_SECRET; empty/unset -> every event 400s (verify_signature returns False on an empty secret). NEVER log/echo this value. (2) BILLING MODELS: Subscription(FK membership.MemberProfile, amount_centavos PositiveIntegerField, status PENDING/ACTIVE/EXPIRED, created_at/updated_at); Payment(FK Subscription, amount_centavos, status PENDING/PAID/FAILED, paymongo_payment_id CharField unique+db_index, created_at/updated_at); WebhookEvent(event_id unique, received_at, status PROCESSED/UNKNOWN_PAYMENT/IGNORED only -- NO signature_valid field, NO DEFERRED status). Amounts are integer centavos. billing.0001_initial depends on membership.0001_initial. Do NOT edit applied migrations. (3) SINGLE-WRITER INVARIANT: apps/billing/services.mark_payment_paid / mark_payment_failed are the ONLY writers of PAID/FAILED; both no-op when the payment is already terminal (PAID or FAILED) so out-of-order redelivery can't flip a settled payment (NIT-4). create_payment_intent(subscription, amount_centavos) is a NotImplementedError stub (PayMongo HTTP client deferred; FEAT-004/billing pass wires create_payment_intent AND must gate it with can_initiate_payment -- the one RBAC row still unenforced). (4) WEBHOOK (apps/billing/webhooks.py, mounted at profit/urls.py path('webhooks/paymongo/', paymongo_webhook), @csrf_exempt + @require_POST). verify_signature(raw_body: bytes, header, secret, *, mode) parses 't=..,te=..,li=..', builds message = t.encode() + b'.' + raw_body (BYTE-EXACT; raw_body is NEVER decoded before hashing), hmac.sha256 hexdigest keyed by secret.encode(), hmac.compare_digest vs te (test) / li (live). Mode is selected from payload data.attributes.livemode (True->live) defaulting to test offline. Idempotency: inside transaction.atomic(), get_or_create(event_id, defaults status=UNKNOWN_PAYMENT) + ALWAYS select_for_update().get(pk=...) re-read; terminal (PROCESSED/IGNORED) duplicate -> 200 no re-apply; whole block wrapped in try/except IntegrityError whose except re-opens atomic + select_for_update().get(event_id=...) + same terminal check. Event-type map: payment.paid/payment.failed -> Payment lookup by paymongo_payment_id (payload data.attributes.data.id); found -> mutator + PROCESSED; not found -> UNKNOWN_PAYMENT (reprocessable); any other type -> IGNORED (terminal). Responses: applied/duplicate/unknown/ignored -> 200; bad or missing signature / unparseable body / missing event id -> 400 with NO WebhookEvent row. Event id is read from payload data.id. NOTE select_for_update is a no-op on SQLite (fine for tests; real locking needs Postgres). SIGNATURE SCHEME IS BINDING-per-Revision-4 but the field names/header casing remain UNCONFIRMED against a real PayMongo sample (design HIGH-1) -- the pre-go-live task to capture a real test-mode event fixture and assert against it is still owed (FEAT-004). The webhook payload-field accessors (_extract_event_id/type/payment_id/_select_mode) assume data.id and data.attributes.{type,livemode,data.id}; adjust these (and the test fixture _event_payload) together when the real schema is confirmed. (5) FINANCE: apps/finance TransactionRecord(FK billing.Payment, amount_centavos, recorded_at) stub; services.monthly_summary(year, month) raises NotImplementedError; views.financial_dashboard gated by role_required(can_view_financials) renders templates/finance/dashboard.html (extends base.html); urls at profit/urls.py path('finance/', include('apps.finance.urls')) -> name 'finance:financial_dashboard' at '/finance/'. Dashboard-gate test overrides STORAGES to the plain StaticFilesStorage because base.html's {% static 'app.css' %} needs the collectstatic manifest (a deploy artifact absent offline) -- any future test that RENDERS a template extending base.html must do the same override or it 500s on the manifest lookup. (6) pg_cron: supabase/cron/membership_expiry.sql is a COMMENTED stub (never auto-runs) that flips membership_memberprofile.membership_status to 'EXPIRED' where expiry_date < Manila current_date; it is NOT ORM-managed (the SOLE AGENTS.md raw-SQL exception), applied MANUALLY against Supabase, and its header warns that renaming the MemberProfile model/app-label/fields requires updating the file by hand. (7) INSTALLED_APPS now includes apps.billing and apps.finance (dotted).
